AT A GLANCE

Highlights in this release

More clarity in DSAR review

Explore conversations, understand decisions and identify records that need attention.

Flexible secure collaboration

Persistent rooms, clearer access controls and easier file sharing.

Better migration visibility

More useful statistics, skipped mailbox reporting and submission monitoring.

Improved archive search

Search archived content and select information for a case.

Explore the changes by product area.

No changes match your search.

01 / PRODUCT AREA

DSAR and privacy

More clarity throughout the review and response process.

ImprovedSD-2597, SD-2633, SD-2647, SD-2675

A clearer conversation review

Review email conversations in a single row, explore branches in a focused thread map, and open a graph when you need a wider view.

NewSD-2756, SD-2786

Build chat moments more easily

Create a chat moment by selecting its two edges, with a live preview as you work. Dismissed moments can also be shown on request.

ImprovedSD-2629, SD-2630, SD-2631

More context for review decisions

See when a disclosure decision was copied, find document custody information, and understand more clearly why an item was not processed.

ImprovedSD-2625, SD-2696

A more useful review rail

Run classification and generate a response pack from the relevant page rail. Reviewers are also warned when a legal hold would exclude a record from the response pack.

ImprovedSD-2686, SD-2804, SD-2829

Request types and policy management

Request types can be associated with cases, and the Policy Centre displays the relevant withhold reasons and span categories for each type.

ImprovedSD-2660, SD-2662

Document dates and redaction checks

Document review displays and filters use original source dates, and attachment file types are retained for redaction checks.

FixedSD-594, SD-735, SD-2685, SD-2688, SD-2710, SD-2712, SD-2881

More dependable review and export

Corrections address review links, retained filters, label save errors, PDF downloads and several issues with review status and filter counts.

02 / PRODUCT AREA

eDiscovery and archive

Find and work with information across your archive.

NewSD-2816

Create case populations from the archive

Search archive content and use sources and filters to select items for a case.

ImprovedSD-2689

Search and manual review

Updates support deterministic eDiscovery searches, lexicons and manually defined review populations.

ImprovedSD-2857, SD-2867

Archive search tools

Administrative archive search includes search submission, results and syntax guidance where the feature is enabled.

ImprovedSD-1277, SD-687

Highlights management

View archived highlight rules and restore them when needed. Save, delete and purge failures are now surfaced to reviewers.

ImprovedSD-2680

Evidence review

The classic eDiscovery evidence list and preview have been aligned with the DSAR review experience.

03 / PRODUCT AREA

Migration and export

Better visibility and more resilient transfer workflows.

ImprovedSD-2642, SD-2668, SD-2775, SD-2783, SD-2785

Migration statistics and visibility

Improvements to live statistics, mailbox counts and stalled-work detection provide a clearer picture of migration progress. Skipped alias mailboxes are included in skipped counts with their reasons.

ImprovedSD-2670, SD-2705, SD-2718

Mimecast submission management

Updates manage query limits and backoff, and provide a per-case submission summary, timeline and burst information.

NewSD-2726

Organise PST exports by mailbox

Choose to place each mailbox’s PST files into its own folder, named using the full mailbox address.

FixedSD-2635, SD-2749, SD-2771

Export and recovery reliability

Corrections address duplicate PST output after timeouts, Quest item rebuild errors and the preservation of original EMLX files when conversion fails.

FixedSD-1579, SD-2671

Import acknowledgements and journal delivery

Import gate acknowledgements and journal identity resolution have been improved to support more reliable processing and audit information.

04 / PRODUCT AREA

Secure collaboration and Simply Sign

Make it easier to share, collaborate and manage access.

NewSD-2674, SD-2692, SD-2729

Persistent collaboration rooms

Persistent rooms support invited members and independently managed access expiry.

ImprovedSD-2753

Clearer room membership

Internal room access and the visibility of members have been clarified.

ImprovedSD-2691, SD-2769

Share files in conversations

Drag and drop attachments into chats, or continue to select files using the file picker. The recipient file pane has also been simplified.

ImprovedSD-2864

Delivery notification visibility

See email notification status for private deliveries.

ImprovedSD-891

Simply Sign experience

The document composer and recipient signing experience have been simplified.

05 / PRODUCT AREA

AI and model connectivity

More dependable model setup and provider compatibility.

ImprovedSD-2603, SD-2724

AI model configuration

Maximum-token settings are detected for supported chat and vision models, and Quick Connect preserves existing provider profiles when another provider is added.

ImprovedSD-2681, SD-2723

Amazon Bedrock connectivity

Connection testing checks that the selected model responds, and the adapter has been updated for newer Claude models.

ImprovedSD-2782

OpenAI-compatible connectivity

Compatibility improvements support Anthropic’s endpoint, including structured responses and image reads.

ImprovedSD-2717, SD-2801

More natural answers

Ask AI responses have been refined, and chat-moment prompts have been improved.

06 / PRODUCT AREA

Administration and integrations

More control and better diagnostic information.

ImprovedSD-2550, SD-2552, SD-2572, SD-2754, SD-2755

Remote collectors and push

Updates improve remote collector settings, key-rotation alerts, large package uploads and visibility of push activity.

NewSD-2730, SD-2768

Remote diagnostics

Administrators can request remote collector log bundles, with additional archive-source diagnostics available for troubleshooting.

ImprovedSD-2758, SD-2802, SD-2806, SD-2807, SD-2885

Outlook and email

Updates improve Outlook diagnostics and recovery guidance, clarify Microsoft 365 outbound email configuration, and make imported email files easier to locate and download.

ImprovedSD-2576, SD-2877

Accounts and notifications

Account management includes an optional live portal, and colleagues can be notified when DSAR input is requested.

NewSD-2582

Native iPhone experience

A native iPhone experience has been developed for My Data and secure collaboration. Availability and deployment details should be confirmed for your environment.

07 / PRODUCT AREA

Security and reliability

Updates that strengthen protection and day-to-day operation.

FixedSD-1289, SD-2604, SD-2610

Access and collection controls

Corrections address document access checks and the application of collection-date filters to unsupported files within ZIP archives.

FixedSD-1024, SD-2708, SD-2709, SD-2757

Review and redaction safeguards

Corrections address reserved-value protections, completion of records awaiting redaction, and the handling of dismissed chat moments.

ImprovedSD-2622, SD-2779, SD-2780, SD-2810

Platform security

Security dependencies and session handling have been updated, including stricter handling of malformed authentication headers.

ImprovedSD-2551

Operational reliability

Updates address shared retry, notification, audit and import-completion behaviour.

Upgrade information

Upgrade steps, configuration changes, availability and any customer action are to be confirmed for this release. Please contact your Simply Discover representative for guidance.
